optimize_torch_function: optimize a PyTorch function with torch._dynamo.optimize to graph capture and call the backend for faster execution
export_pytorch_function: export a PyTorch function to an FX graph format that can be executed outside of PyTorch with symbolic shape support
explain_dynamo_tracing: explain why a PyTorch function has graph breaks during Dynamo tracing and display the captured graphs
optimize_assert_pytorch: optimize a PyTorch function with torch._dynamo.optimize_assert to enforce a single whole-program graph with no graph breaks
check_dynamo_support: check if TorchDynamo is supported on the current platform and Python version before using torch.compile
